senses.gloss: योक्तव्य᳙ mfn. to be joined or yoked or united &c.
to be concentrated (as the mind), MBh.
to be prepared or employed or practised or applied, TS.; Bhag. (n. impers.)
to be entrusted or charged with (loc.), ib.
to be furnished or provided with (instr.), ib.; Hariv.
योक्तव्य योक्तृ, योक्त्र See p. 854, col. 3.
योक्तृ॑ mfn. one who yokes or harnesses, a charioteer, MBh.
one who excites or rouses, VS.
one who applies effort to (loc.), Āpast.
यो॑क्त्र n. any instrument for tying or fastening, a rope, thong, halter, RV. &c. &c. (also -पाश, m.)
the thongs by which an animal is attached to the pole of a carriage, MBh.
the tie of the yoke of a plough, L.
योक्त्र—पाश m., any instrument for tying or fastening, a rope, thong, halter
योक्त्रय Nom. P. ˚यति, to tie, bind, fasten, wind round, MBh.
योक् ind. = ज्योक्, for a long time g. स्वर्-आदि.
